author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as a Devanagari glyph (flat arm bar with a hooked leg and a detached check-mark bird); redrawn like the reference: a figure balancing on one straight leg with arms spread wide and raised slightly, the other leg lifted with the knee bent and shin hanging, a ground line broken under the lifted foot, and a gull-winged bird at the upper left.
omissions: Figure drawn as a stick figure instead of the reference's outlined limbs.
